verdict.line: You lose if you stand in her E stun window or let her passive cap out before you can punish; you win by stunning her Bladesurge dashes and all-inning once R comes online at 6.

brief.thesis: Volibear's kit is a short-cooldown, close-range stun-and-heal engine (Q every 10-12s, W every 5s) while Irelia's offense is front-loaded into two commitments — Bladesurge's dash and Flawless Duet's converging stun. Neither of her tools deals sustained damage on its own, so every dash or stun she throws and misses is a trade you win. That structural gap is why Volibear sits at 53.6% over 194 games against her despite a middling 48.4% overall top-lane winrate.

theirWindow.what: Flawless Duet throws two blades that converge and stun plus Mark anything caught between them; don't dance in melee range while it's available, since getting stunned there chains into a free Q (Bladesurge) reset and real damage.

yourWindow.when: She just cast Q (Bladesurge) onto you
yourWindow.what: Bladesurge puts her in your face on a 10-6s cooldown with no follow-up ready; answer instantly with your own Q (Thundering Smash) at 300 range to Stun her, then chain W (Frenzied Maul) twice for the recast bonus damage and heal.

powerCurve.note: Neither has a real combo online yet
W charge damage and Q sustain outtrade you
Her item/cooldown spikes meet your long R
Tank build and shorter R dominate skirmishes

start.why: Picked in 69.5% of these matchups at 56.6% win rate; the mana regen keeps Frenzied Maul and Sky Splitter spammable through early trades instead of running dry by level 4.

boots.why: Taken in 63% of games at 53.4% win rate; Irelia's damage compounds through stacked Ionian Fervor autos, so flat physical reduction blunts her exactly where she scales.

core.why: First piece of the highest-performing path measured (87.5% win rate over 16 games) and a mythic-style base for the fight-sustain items behind it.
Attack speed feeds the Frenzied Maul double-cast loop and keeps Thundering Smash's attack-speed steroid relevant into mid game.
Boosts the healing from W's recast and R's bonus health, turning every extended trade into a sustain war you win.

situational.when: she's stacking lifesteal or crit and starting to out-damage your sustain in extended fights
she's all-inning you with autos before level 3, before Ionian Fervor is worth respecting
you're already ahead and want to convert the lead into wave pressure and poke range
you want added magic damage and healing out of your W/E combo instead of the Navori path

runes.keystoneWhy: Taken on the highest win-rate page (53.6%, 27.2% pick); its ramping attack speed matches Frenzied Maul's 5s recast window and keeps your auto-reset trades scaling as long as a fight runs, which favors your durability over her burst.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 71.9% and the highest win rate (58.2%) of any combo measured; Ignite cuts into Bladesurge's healing and closes out the solo kills Volibear is already favored to get in this matchup.

playing.title: Punish every Bladesurge dash
playing.detail: Q (Bladesurge) leaves her standing in your face on cooldown with nothing else ready. The instant she dashes in, answer with your own Q (Thundering Smash) at 300 range to stun her before she can disengage.

playing.title: Track E cooldown all lane
playing.detail: Flawless Duet is a 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s skillshot that stuns and Marks anyone caught between the two converging blades. Only commit to extended trades once you've seen it thrown and whiffed.

playing.title: Double-tap W on every stand-and-fight
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul is up roughly every 5 seconds, and recasting it on the same target adds bonus damage plus a heal for you. Chain W into W any time she's forced to stay in melee range.

playing.title: Respect her passive stack count
playing.detail: Per OP.GG, check her Ionian Fervor stacks before extending. At max stacks she adds bonus on-hit damage, so pull out of trades before she caps rather than feeding her strongest window.

playing.title: Zone with E poke before diving
playing.detail: Sky Splitter hits from 1200 range, slows, and shields you if you're standing in the blast. Use it to soften her and deny CS before you commit Q.

playing.title: Save R for a clean window
playing.detail: Stormbringer lands from level 6 onward and grants bonus health on cast. Hold it until her W (Defiant Dance) damage-reduction charge or her E is down, since diving into either lets her out-trade the leap.

playing.title: All-in from level 6 to 8
playing.detail: Volibear holds the solo-kill advantage in this matchup. Once R is live, look to force fights with Q stun into double W and Ignite rather than passively farming through this window.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are the actual picks and win rates from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning — stun windows, dash punishes, and timing calls — is my own read of the ability kits, not something OP.GG measures.

stats.opponentTip: Check Irelia’s (P) and Conqueror stacks before fighting her. Avoid her (E) and deal damage with [Q][E] before retreating.
